config.fun_with_friends.title: Fun With Friends Options
config.fun_with_friends.option.party_sys: Allows players to form parties and travel together.
config.fun_with_friends.option.max_party: Maximum number of players allowed in a single party.
config.fun_with_friends.option.mount_boo: Grants speed bonus when riding together.
config.fun_with_friends.option.item_hand: Pass items directly to another player's inventory or hands.
Maximum distance required to hand items or interact with players.
config.fun_with_friends.option.pull_mech: Allows pulling another player towards yourself.
config.fun_with_friends.option.pull_dist: Maximum distance to reach and pull another player.
config.fun_with_friends.option.health_sh: Sacrifice health to restore health to a teammate.
Amount of HP transferred per interaction.
config.fun_with_friends.option.high_five: High-five a friend to receive temporary status effects.
config.fun_with_friends.option.potato_th: Allows throwing poisonous potatoes to apply effects on hit.
config.fun_with_friends.option.slimeball: Allows throwing slimeballs to slow down hit targets.
config.fun_with_friends.option.tnt_throw: Allows throwing primed TNT blocks with Shift + Right Click.
config.fun_with_friends.option.enable_bo: Increases boss max health dynamically depending on nearby player count.
config.fun_with_friends.option.boss_scal: Percentage of base max health added per additional player.
config.fun_with_friends.option.boss_max_: Upper cap limit for boss health scaling.
config.fun_with_friends.option.enable_ha: Allows equipping decorative items onto your helmet slot using Shift + Right Click.
config.fun_with_friends.option.allow_blo: Allows equipping glass, flowers, pots, chests, dripstone, end rods, pressure plates, ice, sea pickles, and chorus flowers.
config.fun_with_friends.option.allow_can: Allows placing up to 4 candles together on your head.
config.fun_with_friends.option.typing_in: Displays typing indicators above players' heads when opening chat.
config.fun_with_friends.option.nick_colo: Unlocks nickname colors for completing advancements.
config.fun_with_friends.option.chat_emoj: Converts shortcodes like :heart: into chat icons.
